description.text: Municipal Securities Rulemaking Board Reform Act of 2026

latestAction.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs.

bill.title: Municipal Securities Rulemaking Board Reform Act of 2026

aiDescription.summary: The bill amends Exchange Act §15B to set MSRB membership: a 15‑member (odd‑number) board with a regulated‑representative majority and minimum broker‑dealer, bank, advisor, and public seats. Those rules govern MSRB appointments, terms, interim members, and SEC removal authority, affecting regulation of brokers, dealers, municipal advisors, municipal entities, and investors.

impact.summary: The bill would amend Section 15B to set MSRB membership rules, 15 members, regulated/public quotas, staggered three‑year terms, and SEC appointment and removal authority. It would affect the MSRB, the SEC, municipal securities brokers and dealers (including bank dealers), municipal advisors, issuers/obligated persons, and investors.
